class.name: OcgGCMakecircle
class.brief_description: Implements construction algorithms for circles in 3D space.
class.description: ! Implements construction algorithms for circles in 3D space. ! ! * Create a circle parallel to another and passing ! through a point. ! * Create a Circle parallel to another at the distance ! Dist. ! * Create a Circle passing through 3 points. ! * Create a Circle with its center and the normal of its ! plane and its radius. ! * Create a Circle with its axis and radius. ! The circle parameter is the angle in radians. ! The parametrization range is [0,2*PI]. ! The circle is a closed and periodic curve. ! The center of the circle is the Location point of its axis ! placement. The XDirection of the axis placement defines the ! origin of the parametrization.

method.name: from_gp_Ax2_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a circle from axis placement and radius.

method.name: from_gp_Circ_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a circle concentric to the input circle with an offset radius.

method.name: from_gp_Circ_const_ref_gp_Pnt_const_ref
method.description: Creates a circle concentric to the input circle and passing through the input point.

method.name: from_gp_Ax1_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a circle from axis and radius.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt_const_ref_gp_Pnt_const_ref_gp_Pnt_const_ref
method.description: Creates a circle passing through three points.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt_const_ref_gp_Dir_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a circle from center point, normal and radius.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt_const_ref_gp_Pnt_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a circle from center point, axis point and radius.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed circle. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no circle is constructed.
